messages:
Maria B.: Quick heads-up — planning a coordinated change window tonight 23:00 UTC. Targets: API v3.4.0, runtime v2.9.1-kernelB, console ui/1.12.0 (feature-flag toggle), router shim-7. Need to lock pins and confirm rollback triggers.
Ashok: Ack. Is runtime kernelB the one with the new KV eviction tweak? Any warmup required?
Maria B.: Yes, kernelB changes eviction heuristics. We'll run a warmup: 30m traffic in staging with perf sync. No manual cache clearing.
Jess: Console needs a tiny feature-flag flip for the new routing header. Will push flag to off in prod by default and enable after API and router are green.
Kai: Router shim-7 has a compatibility shim; if shim-7 drops <1% of traffic in canary we should fail fast.
Charlie: Rollback criteria proposal: 1) API 5xx rate >0.5% sustained 5m, 2) tail latency P95 up >100ms vs baseline, 3) router error spike or >0.2% dropped requests. Agree?
Ashok: Add KV cache miss rate >10% sustained as a trigger (runtime specific).
Jess: Also add console 500s >0.3% or UI error banner showing.
Maria B.: Good catches. Final rollback list: API 5xx>0.5%, API P95 +100ms, runtime KV-miss>10%, router drop>0.2%, console 500s>0.3%.
deploy-bot: Wave scheduled: 2026-03-21T23:00:00Z. Preflight smoke at T-15m. Stagger: router -> runtime -> api -> console. Canary 2% for 10m, then 20m at 20% before full.
Kai: Stagger order ok but router first so we can short-circuit routing on failures. Confirmed.
Charlie: Where do we pin model/service versions? I assume deploy manifests will include image tags and runtime config pins.
Maria B.: Yes — manifests in k8s repo: api: redwood/api:v3.4.0, runtime: redwood/runtime:v2.9.1-kernelB, router: redwood/router:shim-7, console: redwood/console:ui-1.12.0. I'll push a fast PR with the pin commit hash.
Ashok: Can we also add a kernel rollout flag to runtime so we can flip back to kernelA without full image rollback? If not, plan B is image rollback.
Maria B.: No hot kernel toggle today. Plan B image rollback acknowledged. Keep rollback playbook ready.
Jess: Release notes snippet drafted — will attach to the PR.
Maria B.: Preflight checklist (short):
- CI green for pinned tags
- Staging warmup + perf baseline (done by 22:15 UTC)
- Alerting hooks enabled: api-5xx, api-p95, runtime-kv-miss, router-drop, console-5xx
- Ops oncall: @Kai, @Charlie, @Ashok from 22:45-00:30 UTC
- Rollback runbook accessible in PR description

Kai: Oncall set. I'll watch the deploybot and keep manual failover ready.
ops-bot: Reminder — create incident channel if rollback initiated. Use /incident create deploy-4360001111
Maria B.: If all good I'll ship the pin PR by 21:30 and tag the wave. Any objections?
Jess: No objections from console side.
Charlie: LGTM.
Ashok: LGTM from runtime. I'll run the staging warmup and paste smoke links here.
Maria B.: Thanks team. I'll post final PR link once pinned. :shipit:
